crossRefs.note: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes…
Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is…
but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is…

translations.web: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
translations.bsb: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
translations.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
translations.asv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
